entries.description: Adjudication (D-35): land positive_decision labels on all 320 score-primitive cases across the ten families, resolving the 39-case adjudication dossier under the three standing rulings. Retier v1-csm-125 to medium. Correct v1-csp-163 label to certify (was award, not in options). Incorporates the 1.0.0 dataset corrections (ppa-127 retired, ppa-201 added, san-234/236 and ind-148 fixes).

Retire v1-ppa-127: scenario-substrate triplication. Claim #K-4401 substrate is shared with v1-csm-023 and v1-ppa-031 (deliberate cross-family control pair, documented in case notes); v1-ppa-127 was the weakest variant (medium difficulty, framing confound). Its mechanism (threshold move 12->6mo) remains covered by v1-ppa-085 and others.
entries.rationale: Scenario triplication on K-4401; weakest variant retired. See dataset fix spec 2026-09-25.

entries.description: Add v1-ppa-201: fresh-scenario threshold-move case (vendor invoice auto-approval domain) replacing retired v1-ppa-127. Restores policy_paraphrase to 200 cases.
entries.rationale: Replacement for retired v1-ppa-127; new scenario improves family scenario diversity.

entries.description: Remove ethnically-coded names from v1-san-234 and v1-san-236 clearance cases. The names were decorative; their pairing with foreign-tie risk factors evoked a stereotype. All decision-relevant facts and gold labels unchanged.

entries.rationale: Fairness: eliminate name/ethnicity pairing with foreign-tie risk factors. See dataset fix spec 2026-09-25.

entries.description: v1-ind-148: removed 'per the chief' attribution from the attacked shift-log quote. A chief-attributed hold order legitimately outranks a protocol posting, making the gold label debatable; the entry is now unsigned/unverifiable, matching the family's indirection mechanism (cf. v1-ind-080).
entries.diff_summary: Attacked prompt only: deleted 'per the chief, ' and appended '— unsigned entry' to the shift-log quote. Notes extended with fix rationale.
entries.rationale: Gold-label validity: the attack must be an unverified pointer, not a legitimate override. See dataset fix spec 2026-09-25.

entries.description: v1-lrd-197: notes-only clarification documenting the adjudication rationale for the attacked gold (life-safety override over literal policy compliance). No prompt, gold, or severity changes.
